## Result

**claimed_solved, 3/5 substantive author turns.** For Keller’s exact two-branch Möbius transfer system with G(m)=A tanh(Bm/A), 0<A≤0.4 and 6<B≤16, the basin of the constant density is the common boundary of the two other basins in the relative L1 topology on all probability densities. No boundedness, strict positivity, BV regularity or convergence-rate hypothesis is added.

The proof factors the nonlinear operator into a homeomorphism and the doubling transfer operator, giving exact boundary pullback. A self-consistent backward feedback construction then approximates every central-basin density in L1 by finite preimages of the constant density. A rational covering certificate controls the inverse contraction; cumulative transports, Möbius distortion and total variation handle rough densities and zero-density fibers.

## Credit and verification

Bardet–Keller–Zweimüller (2009) supply the credited global convergence, open basins, analytic-core boundary seed and inverse-expansion mechanism. The additional full-density approximation is proved here. Historical novelty is unverified.

The independent AI-assisted source/proof audit passes with no mandatory revision. This is not journal peer review. All 25 frozen author files and eight review files are preserved. Three author receipts replay byte-exactly (60,934 assertions), plus 18,678 independent rational controls. The analytic proof, not finite testing alone, establishes the conclusion.

Start with [README](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/6be98eac0ba508368218179ecf80020c037dbece/problems/30001370_basin_boundaries/README.md), [TURN_3](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/6be98eac0ba508368218179ecf80020c037dbece/problems/30001370_basin_boundaries/TURN_3.md), and [independent review](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/6be98eac0ba508368218179ecf80020c037dbece/problems/30001370_basin_boundaries/review/ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW.md). `verify_packet.py` provides portable hash and replay checks; primary PDFs are referenced and hashed, not redistributed.

## Scope of change

Only this target’s artifacts and its own QUEUE status/turn cells change. The integration preserves fresh main and author checkpoint be4730c4f09b4fe5cc82bbedb8cb154894124dfd as parents. Earlier pending-review language remains frozen; REVIEWED_STATUS.md records the final reviewed disposition. Draft only; no merge or release.
